issues.description: The example usage in the template Main.java calls a method named feed(), but the problem statement and reference solution expect feedAllAnimals(). This name/signature mismatch between the template example and the specified API can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (matching the problem statement and solution) or add a small wrapper method feed() in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() to preserve the example while keeping the intended API.

issues.description: The example Main in the template repository calls farm.feed(), while the problem statement and solution expect the method to be named feedAllAnimals(). This mismatched identifier for the same conceptual action (feeding all animals) can confuse students when mapping the described API to the provided starter code and the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the call in the template Main from farm.feed() to farm.feedAllAnimals(), or add a small compatibility wrapper method feed() in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals(). This aligns the template example with the problem statement and solution while keeping student confusion minimal.
